name: Kit Fisto's Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor
wookieepedia_title: Kit Fisto's Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor
description: Kit Fisto flew a Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor during the Clone Wars. It could be used in combination with a hyperdrive docking ring, a device used to achieve faster-than-light travel by starships with no onboard hyperdrive.

data.name: Kit Fisto's Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor
